title: Andrew Berry: We've enjoyed the time we've spent with Ty Simpson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andrew Berry: We've enjoyed the time we've spent with Ty Simpson
sources.description: During the scouting combine, former Alabama quarterback Ty Simpson said that it would be a "dream come true" to play for new Browns head coach Todd Monken, who the signal-caller has known for years as a family friend.
